heading: What the yard quotes
lede: Ten classes on the order desk, quoted in HEZE. The desk sums them with CSS counters — the running total on the docket is arithmetic done by the layout engine, with no script on the page.

grid.p: Ten classes × slip × drive × flight × escort × four fittings × eleven conventional mounts.
The yard fits no nuclear weapons and there is no option to order them. Every mount you check is drawn on the band under the hull.

text: The order desk's ten classes, quoted in HEZE, and how many distinct orders the desk can actually take.
